step1_analysis.description: A subthreshold transconductor that generates an output current proportional to the hyperbolic sine (sinh) of the differential input voltage. It utilizes a parallel NMOS and PMOS pair to achieve an expansive sinh characteristic, which is typically used to linearize compressive tanh differential pairs.

paper_reference.title: A sinh Resistor and Its Application to tanh Linearization

sky130_expected.calculation: Gm ≈ I_bias / (2 * n * V_T). With Vb=0.54V, I_bias ≈ 2uA, n ≈ 1.5, V_T = 26mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends strongly on the exact subthreshold bias current set by Vb=0.54V.
Expected to be similar to the paper's reported 46 dB, limited by the simple current mirror and tail current source output resistance.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3dB ≈ Gm / (2 * pi * C_parasitic). With Gm=25uS and C~50fF.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The intrinsic bandwidth of the OTA in SKY130 will be in the MHz range, much higher than the 20kHz application frequency.
Subthreshold operation results in very low power consumption.

Iout_max.description: Maximum output current in sinh expansive region

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the exponential increase in current before leaving subthreshold.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The sinh characteristic allows the current to expand beyond the quiescent bias current, unlike a standard tanh differential pair.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure Gm, CMRR, Bandwidth, Power, and DC sinh characteristic of the transconductor.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Sinh Resistor Transconductor Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_p=2u L_p=1u
.param W_n=2u L_n=1u

* DUT (T replaced with M for standard SPICE, N3 mapped to VDD)
M3 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W={W_p} L={L_p}
M6 N2 Vb GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
M4 Vout N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W={W_p} L={L_p}
M5 Vout Vout N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
M1 N1 V1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
M2 N2 V2 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W={W_p} L={L_p}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB Vb 0 0.54

VCM VCM 0 DC 0.9 AC 0
Vdiff Vdiff 0 DC 0 AC 1

* E-sources for differential inputs (V1, V2)
E1 V1 VCM Vdiff 0 0.5
E2 V2 VCM Vdiff 0 -0.5

* Output load (force voltage to measure short-circuit current)
Vmeas Vout 0 0.9

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * DM AC Analysis
  alter Vdiff ac=1
  alter VCM ac=0
  ac dec 10 1 100Meg
  let adm = mag(i(Vmeas))
  meas ac gm_dm find adm at=10
  meas ac bw_3db when adm='gm_dm/1.414' fall=1

  * CM AC Analysis
  alter Vdiff ac=0
  alter VCM ac=1
  ac dec 10 1 100Meg
  let acm = mag(i(Vmeas))
  meas ac gm_cm find acm at=10

  * CMRR
  let cmrr_db = 20*log10(gm_dm / gm_cm)
  print cmrr_db

  * DC Sweep for Sinh characteristic
  alter Vdiff ac=0
  alter VCM ac=0
  dc Vdiff -0.5 0.5 0.01
  meas dc iout_max max i(Vmeas)
  meas dc iout_min min i(Vmeas)

  quit
.endc
.end
